On the night of 19 July 2030, in a fire in a row house in Bridgeport, retired police detective Walt Brennan (72) was found dead in the armchair in his living room.

The fire was reported at 00.21 by his neighbour Grace Okafor. The fire department arrived at 00.29. The homeowner’s daughter Megan Brennan and son-in-law Kyle Duffy were informed the same night.

The autopsy showed the victim was alive and sedated in the fire, the door camera the son-in-law’s real leaving time. The laboratory line gave the print on the battery, the financial line the debt. The archive line gave not the killer but Walt’s Lakeshore notebook: Container 22 and ‘E.’
The third line didn’t solve this file. But it may change the next one.
Bridgeport — July 2030

Kyle Duffy planned to clear his $120,000 betting debt with his father-in-law’s life policy. At the Thursday dinner he put a sleeping drug in Walt Brennan’s whisky, waited until he fell asleep, took the battery out of the detector and put the cigarette among the newspapers. Walt never woke.
